stoich-roadmap.alt: A flow diagram. Grams of A (divide by molar mass) or volume of a solution of A (multiply by molarity) lead to moles of A. Moles of A times the mole ratio, moles of B over moles of A, gives moles of B. Moles of B lead to grams of B (multiply by molar mass) or to a volume of a solution of B (divide by molarity). The mole ratio comes from the coefficients of the balanced equation.
